column1: # Cue words for context-cued numbers (languages/cues.py; docs/languages.md); format in
# hu/cues.tsv. Italian nouns do not decline: a trailing "*" covers the plural and the compounds
# that keep the stem (telefono, telefonico). Elided forms are listed with their apostrophe
# ("carta d'identità"); matching ignores case and accents.
# Not "e" (and): matching ignores accents, so it would also be "è" (is), which often
# stands between a cue and its value ("il mio cellulare è 333 ...").
